title: Council of Civil Service Unions v. Minister for the Civil Service

content.caseIdentity: Council of Civil Service Unions v. Minister for the Civil Service, [1985] AC 374
content.facts: The case concerned review of executive power and prerogative decision-making.
questionsBeforeCourt: What grounds structure modern judicial review?
content.ratioDecidendi: Illegality, irrationality and procedural impropriety provide the classic grounds, subject to the Indian constitutional framework when applied in India.
content.holding: The House of Lords articulated the familiar classification later adopted in Indian administrative-law discourse.
content.relevance: Use only as persuasive comparative authority, not as Indian binding precedent.
